notes.title: Three ways to answer
notes.science: Gottman sorts the replies to a bid three ways: toward, away, and against. Here they are a warm answer, a still sky, and a rumble.
notes.limits: One wave is a tiny sample. A real bond rests on thousands of small replies.
notes.counter: In some homes and cultures, a quiet reply is the kind one.
notes.question: When does no answer hurt more than a bad one?

sources.label: Simply Psychology on the limits of the bid research

notes.title: One wave moves a little
notes.science: Each reply moves Pim's warmth toward the sky a little way, never all the way.
notes.limits: The size of each move is a number someone tuned by hand. Real hearts do not share one step size.
notes.counter: Some first meetings stay with people far longer than any later one.
notes.question: How many waves would it take to change Pim's mind about you?

sources.label: The Evolution of Trust, Nicky Case
